newsitem.title: USA: Chevron says Galvin resigns at Chevron unit.
newsitem.headline: Chevron says Galvin resigns at Chevron unit.

text.p: Chevron Corp. said Thursday that Ray Galvin will retire as corporate vice president and president of Chevron U.S.A. Production Co., its U.S. exploration and production unit, at the end of February at the company's mandatory retirement age of 65.
Peter Robertson, 49, corporate vice president of strategic planning and quality, will replace Galvin, and Greg Matiuk, 51, has been put in Robertson's spot.
Chevron's stock fell 75 cents to $61.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
